{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to customers who converted
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out invalid age entries (customer_age == -1)
valid_age_df = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute and print the number of converted customers
print(f"Number of customers who converted: {len(converted_df)}")

# Compute and print the number of converted customers with invalid age (-1)
print(f"Number of converted customers with invalid age (-1): {len(converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] == -1])}")

# Compute and print the number of converted customers with valid age
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(valid_age_df)}")

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_age_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Print mean age
print(f"Mean age of converted customers with valid age: {mean_age}")

# Round to two decimal places for final answer
rounded_mean_age = round(mean_age, 2)
print(f"Rounded mean age: {rounded_mean_age}")"}
